title: A safe place for unhoused single women and women with children
description:
A safe place for unhoused single women and women with children. ❤️ 

We recently marked the expansion of the Rachel’s Promise Center for Women and Children, growing from 50 to 210 beds. The expansion was made possible through a public-private partnership. Property owners Dene Oliver and Jim McMillan worked with Catholic Charities, the City and the San Diego Housing Commission on improvements needed to expand the shelter and create spaces that offer greater safety, privacy and dignity for women and children: insidesandiego.org/women-and-families-experiencing-homelessness-find-safe-space-through-rachels-promise-center
